key_insight: A vision-transformer model analyzes narrow-band laryngoscopy images to classify benign vs malignant lesions while pairing predictions with segment-based explanations for clinicians.
clinical_relevance: This could support earlier laryngeal cancer screening by reducing reliance on manual interpretation and making AI outputs more interpretable in endoscopy workflows.
method: Transformer + attention model for NBI endoscopy image classification
MedSAM-based segmentation to highlight pathological regions
Fusion of classification and explanation for screening support
evidence_signal: The abstract reports F1 of 82.72% and accuracy of 82.33% for benign/malignant classification.
watch_item: Performance is reported only from the abstract, so external validation, dataset size, and real-world generalizability remain unclear.
paper_title: Medical Imaging Fusing Vision Transformer: Laryngeal Cancer Screening with Explanation
